messages:
ravi: kicking off a thread for a proposed 'smokelet' gate: an ultra-fast pre-ingest sanity+mini-bench that runs in ~1-5s to catch obvious tokenizer, decode, and perf surprises before deeper benching.
esther: sounds good. want it to be feature-flagged per-registry and per-team to avoid extra cost for bulk uploads.
tom: what checks exactly? i propose: tokenizer roundtrip, token-count invariants, deterministic-seed sample, tiny p95 latency probe, and a compact behavioural delta score against a lightweight golden.
nina: naming nit: 'smokelet' is fine. add an explicit hard vs soft semantics doc. hard = block intake; soft = label for follow-up and schedule a full mini-bench.
ravi: agreed. soft should create a ticket with the most informative diff (tokenization diff snippet + top-3 divergent outputs). include quick re-run link.
jax: for determinism we must standardize decode args: temp=0, top_k=0, top_p=1, do_sample=false, max_new_tokens=24. avoid beam to keep it simple.
esther: defaults for the job: samples=8, seq_len=20, timeout=3s, concurrency=4. configurable in model-manifest under 'smokelet'.
tom: propose a compact fingerprint format stored in registry: tokenizer_id, merges_sha/vocab_sha, special_tokens_hash, quant_format. smokelet can short-circuit if fingerprint matches a known-good row.
nina: security note: customer golden traces are opt-in. we only store salted output hashes and per-customer salts live in KMS. QA must approve.
qa-bot: smokelet queued for model redwood/aurora-lite at 4887654330.
qa-bot: smokelet result: redwood/aurora-lite -> status=soft, token_count_ok=true, roundtrip_ok=false, det_match=low, p95=18ms. golden_match=skipped.
ravi: looks like roundtrip failed; likely tokenizer normalization differences. please capture the example input and token lists in the ticket.
esther: for docs: define the scoring heuristic. behaviour_delta = weighted( token_count_diff*10 + token_edit_distance*5 + semantic-divergence_score ). threshold>15 => hard block. 8-15 => soft. <8 => pass.
tom: we should avoid heavy semantic checks — stick to surface signals but allow a lightweight embedding similarity probe for edgecases. keep it optional.
nina: Console UX: show badge states: smokelet:pass | smokelet:review | smokelet:block. each shows a one-line reason and a re-run button. link to ticket when created.
ravi: runner changes: limit concurrent smokelets per-intake-worker to 3 to avoid thrash. instrument metrics: smokelet-latency, smokelet-flake-rate, smokelet-advisory-rate.
jax: one more: quantized format must be included in fingerprint (e.g., int8-ptq, int8-q4, fp16). otherwise tiny decode differences will not be caught.
esther: followups: 1) manifest schema change, 2) runner enforce decode args, 3) Console badge + rerun action, 4) security approval for golden hashes, 5) RFC patch with acceptance matrix.
qa-bot: smokelet finished for redwood/aurora-lite: triage-ticket-created=#3456 (roundtrip token mismatch).
ravi: thanks. aiming for opt-in alpha in 2 sprints, opt-out by config rather than opt-in later. will write RFC and ping reviewers.
